extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.4 - BingeTV starts faster: Home shows its rows as it opens (kept from last time), and the service waits a moment before starting up so the rows load first. Nothing changes elsewhere. v0.17.3 - On Kodi 22, add-on settings files from Kodi 21 (e.g. after restoring a backup) are saved once in Kodi 22's format, so Kodi stops converting them on every load. Nothing changes on Kodi 21.
